decisions.title: Consolidate App Caching into PostgreSQL Unlogged Tables
decisions.rationale: Avoid operational overhead of running multi-region Redis cluster given Postgres meets latency SLAs

decisions.title: Feed Service reads user timeline cache from PostgreSQL
decisions.rationale: High-throughput timeline cache leverages unified PostgreSQL connection pool

decisions.title: Notification Service token invalidation lookup via Postgres unlogged cache
decisions.rationale: Ensures instant auth token revocation check within main DB network boundary

decisions.title: Search Autocomplete Service stores query hints in Postgres cache
decisions.rationale: Shared cached query suggestions without extra Redis memory footprint

decisions.title: Migrate Global Subscription Billing to Stripe Elements & Custom Payouts
decisions.rationale: Single gateway simplifies accounting and offers favorable negotiated EU processing rates

decisions.title: Zero-Surcharge Euro Pricing for European B2B Customers
decisions.rationale: Interchange waiver allows passing direct 0% conversion margin to European customers

decisions.title: Launch €3.99/mo Developer Starter Tier without minimum transaction fees
decisions.rationale: Unit economics hold only if processing fee stays strictly under 1.5%
